* A strong portfolio with digital marketing collateral – only those with a portfolio will be considered
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
* Familiarity with prompt\-based AI copy and design tools is an asset
* Basic experience with motion design
* Knowledge of digital design process and best practices, including image optimization, responsive design, accessibility compliance, basic HTML and CSS, and content management systems
* Excellent time management and organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects concurrently
* High level of initiative and curiosity around process efficiencies and design operations

* Open\-minded and able to give and take constructive feedback
* Proficiency in French or experience in bilingual design is an asset

If you are unsure whether your experience matches every requirement above, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are looking for varied perspectives which include diverse experiences that we can add to our team.

Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal background check. Details will be provided through the application process.

Job Description: Sporting Life is a proudly Canadian sports lifestyle brand, inspiring people to live, enjoy, and enable the sporting life since 1979\.
  
From skiing and running to biking and tennis, we offer the best gear for those who live an active lifestyle.
  
As part of Sporting Life Group, alongside Golf Town and Team Town, we blend sport and style to help Canadians get outside and keep moving.
  
  

Why Work Here?
  
* Access to our benefits package, with the choice of different levels of health, dental, and vision coverage to suit you.
* Employee discounts at Golf Town, Sporting Life, and Team Town Sports that are shareable with friends and family.
* Team\-first culture that celebrates an active, sports lifestyle.
* Fun, fast\-paced hybrid environment where your passion for sport and style belongs.
* Vendor Pro Deals and expert product training to fuel your knowledge and performance.
* A salary range of $55,000 \- $60,000 (dependent on experience), bonus, and opportunities to grow your career in the sports lifestyle.


What You’ll Do;
  
The Graphic Designer will be responsible for developing digital creative assets, including email campaigns, mobile and desktop web content, and performance marketing assets across digital and social media platforms. This role is primarily production\-focused, requiring strong execution skills in creating and adapting creative assets across multiple channels while maintaining brand consistency. Experience with animation and video content for web and social media is considered an asset. This position also offers significant opportunities for professional growth and creative development.
  
  

* Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to develop creative assets and design solutions for e\-commerce, performance marketing, digital campaigns, and, when required, print and other promotional materials.
* Develop and maintain efficient production workflows to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of all creative assets.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to create clean, user\-focused, and visually compelling designs that align with business objectives.
* Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while adapting to shifting priorities and evolving deadlines.
* Ensure all creative work consistently reflects Sporting Life's brand identity, maintaining alignment with the company's mission, vision, and overall brand strategy.
* Contribute to the ideation and execution of creative concepts for brand campaigns, retail activations, and seasonal marketing initiatives, ensuring ideas are innovative, on\-brand, and aligned with business objectives.


What You’ll Bring;
  
* 3\+ years of experience in graphic/web design/production artist.
* Good knowledge of graphic design, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, Animate (Optional). Figma is a plus.
* Understanding of different content types and marketing channels across a customer journey to grab attention and drive engagement.
* Proficiency within a Mac required.
* Strong understanding of the creative process, organizational skills \& file management.
* Ability to adapt creative for French markets. I.e. Working with Translation Services to integrate supplied French and adapt creative to suit regional and language differences.
* Keen eye for detail, organizational skills and meticulousness.
* Ability to work within the constraints of a fast\-paced retail marketing environment and also shift to creative, bigger picture initiatives.

Job Description: **Job Summary**

Paragon Designs is a fast\-growing event printing and production company specializing in custom dance floors, welcome signs, seating charts, backdrops, wall graphics, vinyl installations, branded displays and other large\-format printed products.

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Graphic Designer** with 2\+ years of experience to join our team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys seeing their designs go beyond the computer screen and become finished, large\-scale products used at weddings, corporate events and special occasions.

What You’ll Do

* Create custom designs for event signage, dance floors, seating charts, welcome signs, backdrops and other printed products
* Prepare client artwork for large\-format printing, cutting and production
* Create accurate print\-ready files with proper dimensions, bleed, colour settings and resolution
* Review customer\-supplied files and make adjustments when required
* Design client proofs and revise artwork based on feedback
* Set up cut paths, contour\-cut files and production\-ready artwork
* Check spelling, sizing, alignment and image quality before files are released to production
* Work closely with the administration and production teams to ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule
* Organize project files using consistent naming and folder structures
* Manage multiple projects while meeting fast\-moving event deadlines
* Assist with creative concepts, mockups and internal design projects when needed

What We’re Looking For

* 2\+ years of professional graphic design experience
* Experience designing for print, signage or large\-format production
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
* Understanding of CMYK colour, bleed, resolution, vector artwork and print\-file preparation
* Strong attention to detail, especially with measurements, spelling and alignment
* Ability to follow brand guidelines and client instructions
* Ability to manage several projects and revisions at the same time
* Strong organization and time\-management skills
* Comfortable working in a deadline\-driven environment
* Positive attitude and willingness to collaborate with a small team

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Adobe InDesign
* Experience preparing files for CNC or flatbed digital cutting

Job Description: **Job Summary**

Paragon Designs is a fast\-growing event printing and production company specializing in custom dance floors, welcome signs, seating charts, backdrops, wall graphics, vinyl installations, branded displays and other large\-format printed products.

* Create custom designs for event signage, dance floors, seating charts, welcome signs, backdrops and other printed products

* Review customer\-supplied files and make adjustments when required

* Check spelling, sizing, alignment and image quality before files are released to production
* Work closely with the administration and production teams to ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule
* Organize project files using consistent naming and folder structures
* Manage multiple projects while meeting fast\-moving event deadlines
* Assist with creative concepts, mockups and internal design projects when needed

What We’re Looking For

* 2\+ years of professional graphic design experience
* Experience designing for print, signage or large\-format production
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
* Understanding of CMYK colour, bleed, resolution, vector artwork and print\-file preparation
* Strong attention to detail, especially with measurements, spelling and alignment
* Ability to follow brand guidelines and client instructions
* Ability to manage several projects and revisions at the same time
* Strong organization and time\-management skills
* Comfortable working in a deadline\-driven environment
* Positive attitude and willingness to collaborate with a small team

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Adobe InDesign
* Experience preparing files for CNC or flatbed digital cutting
* Familiarity with registration marks, contour\-cut paths, bleeds and large\-format printing
* Experience working with RasterLink, Mimaki equipment, Onyx or similar print\-production softwares
* Experience designing for weddings, events, retail displays or corporate graphics
* Photography, video editing or social media design experience is an asset

What Success Looks Like

* Client proofs are creative, accurate and delivered on time
* Production files require minimal corrections
* Artwork is properly sized and prepared before printing or cutting
* Deadlines are carefully tracked and communicated
* Files are organized so that other team members can quickly locate and understand them
* You take ownership of your projects from the initial design through final production

Why Join Paragon Designs?

* Work on creative projects that become real, large\-scale installations
* Build experience in print production, signage and event design
* Join a collaborative and growing company
* Work on a wide variety of projects rather than repeating the same type of design
* See your work displayed at some of the GTA’s leading venues and events

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* On\-site parking
* Work from home

Job Description: **Job Summary**

Paragon Designs is a fast\-growing event printing and production company specializing in custom dance floors, welcome signs, seating charts, backdrops, wall graphics, vinyl installations, branded displays and other large\-format printed products.

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Graphic Designer** with 2\+ years of experience to join our team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys seeing their designs go beyond the computer screen and become finished, large\-scale products used at weddings, corporate events and special occasions.

What You’ll Do

* Create custom designs for event signage, dance floors, seating charts, welcome signs, backdrops and other printed products
* Prepare client artwork for large\-format printing, cutting and production
* Create accurate print\-ready files with proper dimensions, bleed, colour settings and resolution
* Review customer\-supplied files and make adjustments when required
* Design client proofs and revise artwork based on feedback
* Set up cut paths, contour\-cut files and production\-ready artwork
* Check spelling, sizing, alignment and image quality before files are released to production
* Work closely with the administration and production teams to ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule
* Organize project files using consistent naming and folder structures
* Manage multiple projects while meeting fast\-moving event deadlines
* Assist with creative concepts, mockups and internal design projects when needed

What We’re Looking For

* 2\+ years of professional graphic design experience
* Experience designing for print, signage or large\-format production
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
* Understanding of CMYK colour, bleed, resolution, vector artwork and print\-file preparation
* Strong attention to detail, especially with measurements, spelling and alignment
* Ability to follow brand guidelines and client instructions
* Ability to manage several projects and revisions at the same time
* Strong organization and time\-management skills
* Comfortable working in a deadline\-driven environment
* Positive attitude and willingness to collaborate with a small team

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Adobe InDesign
* Experience preparing files for CNC or flatbed digital cutting
* Familiarity with registration marks, contour\-cut paths, bleeds and large\-format printing
* Experience working with RasterLink, Mimaki equipment, Onyx or similar print\-production softwares
* Experience designing for weddings, events, retail displays or corporate graphics
* Photography, video editing or social media design experience is an asset

What Success Looks Like

* Client proofs are creative, accurate and delivered on time
* Production files require minimal corrections
* Artwork is properly sized and prepared before printing or cutting
* Deadlines are carefully tracked and communicated
* Files are organized so that other team members can quickly locate and understand them
* You take ownership of your projects from the initial design through final production

Why Join Paragon Designs?

* Work on creative projects that become real, large\-scale installations
* Build experience in print production, signage and event design
* Join a collaborative and growing company
* Work on a wide variety of projects rather than repeating the same type of design
* See your work displayed at some of the GTA’s leading venues and events

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and portfolio with examples of relevant graphic design work. Applications without a portfolio may not be considered.

We appreciate all applications; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Pay: $18\.00\-$26\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Flexible schedule
* On\-site parking
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mississauga, ON L5T 2K4
